about: Pin escapes laid BEFORE trunk.py (phase 2 round 2, lead; replaces p2-pins-u403.json). The 5 mm PACK_P B.Cu trunk keeps the path of runs/p2-m1 (along the south of U403, then north in a 2 mm neck under pins 8 to 10, x 112.3..114.3): the vias of round 2's first table (pins 7 and 9 straight south) pushed the trunk onto a diagonal under pins 1 to 6, which closed I2CC_SCL, I2CC_SDA and CHG_INT and raised J113 from 2.11 to 2.65 mohm (runs/p2a-r5f). Here pins 1, 2, 3 and 7, CE_N at R435.2 and REGN at R415.1 get their vias in the row south of the pins, which closes the diagonal to the trunk, and the vias of pins 9 and 10 sit EAST of the neck (north of TH104's B.Cu pads), so the trunk only gets a notch. Call: pins.py --rules=table --table=plan/p2-pins-u403b.json, before trunk.py.

escapes.why: Port 1 I2CC_SCL to R403.2 (26 mm north, inner layer): west out of the pin to a via at 108.45,110.4, under pin 36 and east of the FSW track (x 107.92); laid before the trunk so the trunk cannot take the row under pins 1 to 6

Port 1 CE_N at its pull-up R435.2: a via straight north at 108.75,111.1 (no other site: FSW runs west of the pad, R415.1 stands east, the trunk is south); the router joins it to the CE_N via of pin 7 on an inner layer
Port 1 I2CC_SDA: a via south at 109.5,111.2, 0.75 mm pitch with the vias of pins 1 and 3
Port 1 CHG_INT: a via south at 110.3,111.2
Port 1 CE_N: south out of the pin and west under the unconnected pins 5 and 6 to a via at 111.1,111.3, so the trunk neck keeps the room between the GND via of R416.2 and the ICHG via

Port 1 REGN at R415.1: every site north of the pad is taken by the vias of pins 1 to 3 and CE_N; a via straight south at 109.64,112.78 (between the pad and the In3 3V3 strap at y 113.44), laid before the trunk, which then keeps 0.25 mm south of it
Port 1 ILIM to R414.1 (6.5 mm east): east out of the last pin of the south row, under pin 11, to a via at 114.75,110.45 east of the trunk neck
Port 1 ICHG to R413.1: south out of the pin, east along y 111.15 under pin 10 to a via at 114.45,111.15 (north-west of R419.2, north of TH104.2 on B.Cu)
Port 1 SW2 to C413.2: pin 19's via (HIDRV2, table of round 2) closes the north; a via east of the pin, laid before the trunk passes there (as the router did on runs/p2-m1)
